rationale: Suspicious: 1 signal(s) needing review; e.g. network request to an off-package external origin.

findings.title: Network request to an off-package external origin
findings.detail: new WebSocket() targets wss://ws.brewswer.io, an origin not in the manifest allowed_origins.

limitations: Static heuristic scan. A GOOD verdict means no known-bad pattern matched, NOT proof of safety. Human review is still required for every submission.
